findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

On arrival the bathroom hand sink was without a hand drying ability. The inspector moved paper towels from the unused “kitchen” sink to the bathroom sink to correct. Ensure that all hand sinks are properly supplied at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less. 

Milk and yogurt were observed in the display coolers with internal temperatures of 46F and 48F. The PIC was shown and instructed to discard the items to correct. The items were discarded during the inspection. Ensure that all TCS foods are maintained at effective cold holding temperatures at all times that they are in coolers.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. 

The display cooler noted in line item #22 is not effectively holding TCS foods at temperature. A follow up is being set for 10 days to ensure that it is adjusted/ corrected.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A).

On arrival there were not reporting agreements or similar paperwork available for staff. Blank copies were found by staff and signed during this inspection to correct. Ensure that reporting agreements of similar paperwork are maintained at this facility at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

On arrival the sani bucket did not register on inspector test strips. The PIC indicated that they remade the bucket yesterday as the most recent time. Education was conducted and the bucket remade during this inspection to correct. Ensure that all sanitizers are at effective concentration at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

The mop is observed stored with the head pooled up in the mop bucket. Education was conducted. Ensure that the mop is stored so that the bristles are able to drip dry effectively moving forward.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. 

The PIC at the time of this inspection has not yet completed the CFPM certification course/test. PIC stated that their wife has the certification and is normally at the facility. It is highly suggested that the PIC during this inspection also complete the course/test so that there are no gaps in when a CFPM is available at the facility.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Th slicer in the facility is observed soiled with food debris during this inspection. The PIC indicated that they had used it two days ago and that it would be cleaned prior to use. Leaving items soiled for prolonged periods of time is not a good practice and should cease immediately. The inspector stated that the items should be cleaned after use instead of before the next use. The slicer was disassembled for cleaning during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. 

Plastic forks are observed in a cardboard container turned towards the customer side of the prep area, next to where customers would stand. These items are also observed with the handles and food contact surfaces intertwined. Storage of single service items was discussed with the PIC and he stated that a shelf was planned along the back wall that these items could be stored on. He also stated that he normally hands these items to consumers himself with a glove.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Test strips are not available for the sanitizer used in the facility (CL/bleach). Test strips were discussed and the PIC took a picture of the inspector’s test strips so that they had an example of what to order/purchase moving foreword. A follow up is being set for 2 weeks to ensure compliance.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11 (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

Sanitizers were not available for use on inspector’s arrival. The inspector walked through creating a sanitizer solution with the PIC and stated that they should be available for use at all times that food services are available.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. 

The PIC at the time of this inspection has not yet completed the CFPM certification course/test. PIC stated that they were in the process and would have it by the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. C (E) FOOD and water TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall have numerical scale, printed record, or digital readout in increments no greater than 1C or 2F in the intended range of use. 

A probe thermometer for checking the internal temperatures of the foods was not available during this inspection. PIC was shown options and is aware that one will be needed in the facility at all times.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
3-304.14: (A) Cloths in-use for wiping FOOD spills for TABLEWARE and carryout containers shall be dry and used for no other purpose. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (E) Containers of sanitizing solution shall be stored off floor and used in manner to prevent contamination. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels. 

Wiping cloths used for food contact surfaces were stored on the counter at the beginning of this inspection. A bucket of sanitizer was made during this inspection and the cloths stored in it to correct.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Test strips were not available at the beginning of this inspection for the CL based sanitizer used in this facility. Testy strips were acquired during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

On arrival there was not a sanitizer prepared and ready for use in the facility. PIC was walked through producing sanitizers of correct concentration and a bucket was made during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment: 1st REPEAT: Provide a self-closer for the back door. Ref. 6-202.15 [C]

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment: 1st REPEAT: Provide a self-closer on the bathroom door. Ref. 6-202.14 [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 1st REPEAT: The ceiling tiles in the bathroom are acoustic (and have tiny holes in them). Replace those with contractor grade ceiling tiles that are smooth and easily cleanable. Ref. 6-501.11 [C]
